This handbook details the Multi-Cloud Strategy Blueprint, a critical initiative designed to extend our robust Azure governance and platform engineering capabilities to a federated multi-cloud environment. It is intended for onboarding engineers and mid-level developers, providing a comprehensive understanding of the architectural foresight and strategic rationale behind this evolution. The primary goal is to validate the proposed federated multi-cloud model, ensuring it effectively extends existing Azure governance to new hyperscalers. Success means stakeholders understand and endorse the architectural approach for specialized AI/ML and data workloads, confirming its alignment with strategic objectives.
